text_en: Paul , a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ , according to the faith of the elect of God and the acknowledging of the truth , which is according to godliness :
text_la: Paulus servus Dei, Apostolus autem Jesu Christi secundum fidem electorum Dei, et agnitionem veritatis, quæ secundum pietatem est
text_pt: Paulo, servo de Deus, e apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, segundo a fé dos eleitos de Deus, e o conhecimento da verdade, que é segundo a piedade,
text_el: Παῦλος δοῦλος θεοῦ, ἀπόστολος δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ κατὰ πίστιν ἐκλεκτῶν θεοῦ καὶ ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας τῆς κατ' εὐσέβειαν

text_en: Unto the hope of life everlasting, which God , who lies not, has promised before the times of the world:
text_la: in spem vitæ æternæ, quam promisit qui non mentitur, Deus, ante tempora sæcularia:
text_pt: Em esperança da vida eterna, a qual Deus, que não pode mentir, prometeu antes dos tempos dos séculos;
text_el: ἐπ' ἐλπίδι ζωῆς αἰωνίου, ἣν ἐπηγγείλατο ὁ ἀψευδὴς θεὸς πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,

text_en: But has in due times manifested his word in preaching, which is committed to me according to the commandment of God our Saviour :
text_la: manifestavit autem temporibus suis verbum suum in prædicatione, quæ credita est mihi secundum præceptum Salvatoris nostri Dei:
text_pt: Mas a seu tempo manifestou a sua palavra pela pregação que me foi confiada segundo o mandamento de Deus, nosso Salvador;
text_el: ἐφανέρωσεν δὲ καιροῖς ἰδίοις τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ ἐν κηρύγματι ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγὼ κατ' ἐπιταγὴν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,

text_en: To Titus, my beloved son according to the common faith , grace and peace, from God the Father and from Christ Jesus our Saviour .
text_la: Tito dilecto filio secundum communem fidem, gratia, et pax a Deo Patre, et Christo Jesu Salvatore nostro.
text_pt: A Tito, meu verdadeiro filho, segundo a fé comum: Graça, misericórdia, e paz da parte de Deus Pai, e da do Senhor Jesus Cristo, nosso Salvador.
text_el: Τίτῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ κατὰ κοινὴν πίστιν: χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν.

text_en: For this cause I left you in Crete: that you should set in order the things that are wanting and should ordain priests in every city, as I also appointed you:
text_la: Hujus rei gratia reliqui te Cretæ, ut ea quæ desunt, corrigas, et constituas per civitates presbyteros, sicut et ego disposui tibi,
text_pt: Por esta causa te deixei em Creta, para que pusesses em boa ordem as coisas que ainda restam, e de cidade em cidade estabelecesses presbíteros, como já te mandei:
text_el: Τούτου χάριν ἀπέλειπόν σε ἐν Κρήτῃ, ἵνα τὰ λείποντα ἐπιδιορθώσῃ καὶ καταστήσῃς κατὰ πόλιν πρεσβυτέρους, ὡς ἐγώ σοι διεταξάμην,

text_en: If any be without crime, the husband of one wife having faithful children, not accused of riot or unruly.
text_la: si quis sine crimine est, unius uxoris vir, filios habens fideles, non in accusatione luxuriæ, aut non subditos.
text_pt: Aquele que for irrepreensível, marido de uma mulher, que tenha filhos fiéis, que não possam ser acusados de dissolução nem são desobedientes.
text_el: εἴ τίς ἐστιν ἀνέγκλητος, μιᾶς γυναικὸς ἀνήρ, τέκνα ἔχων πιστά, μὴ ἐν κατηγορίᾳ ἀσωτίας ἢ ἀνυπότακτα.

text_en: For a bishop must be without crime, as the steward of God : not proud , not subject to anger , nor given to wine, no striker, not greedy of filthy lucre:
text_la: Oportet enim episcopum sine crimine esse, sicut Dei dispensatorem : non superbum, non iracundum, non vinolentum, non percussorem, non turpis lucri cupidum:
text_pt: Porque convém que o bispo seja irrepreensível, como despenseiro da casa de Deus, não soberbo, nem iracundo, nem dado ao vinho, nem espancador, nem cobiçoso de torpe ganância;
text_el: δεῖ γὰρ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ἀνέγκλητον εἶναι ὡς θεοῦ οἰκονόμον, μὴ αὐθάδη, μὴ ὀργίλον, μὴ πάροινον, μὴ πλήκτην, μὴ αἰσχροκερδῆ,

text_en: But given to hospitality, gentle, sober, just , holy , continent:
text_la: sed hospitalem, benignum, sobrium, justum, sanctum, continentem,
text_pt: Mas dado à hospitalidade, amigo do bem, moderado, justo, santo, temperante;
text_el: ἀλλὰ φιλόξενον, φιλάγαθον, σώφρονα, δίκαιον, ὅσιον, ἐγκρατῆ,

text_en: Embracing that faithful word which is according to doctrine, that he may be able to exhort in sound doctrine and to convince the gainsayers.
text_la: amplectentem eum, qui secundum doctrinam est, fidelem sermonem : ut potens sit exhortari in doctrina sana, et eos qui contradicunt, arguere.
text_pt: Retendo firme a fiel palavra, que é conforme a doutrina, para que seja poderoso, tanto para admoestar com a sã doutrina, como para convencer os contradizentes.
text_el: ἀντεχόμενον τοῦ κατὰ τὴν διδαχὴν πιστοῦ λόγου, ἵνα δυνατὸς ᾖ καὶ παρακαλεῖν ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ καὶ τοὺς ἀντιλέγοντας ἐλέγχειν.

text_en: For there are also many disobedient, vain talkers and seducers: especially they who are of the circumcision .
text_la: Sunt enim multi etiam inobedientes, vaniloqui, et seductores : maxime qui de circumcisione sunt:
text_pt: Porque há muitos desordenados, faladores, vãos e enganadores, principalmente os da circuncisão,
text_el: Εἰσὶν γὰρ πολλοὶ ἀνυπότακτοι, ματαιολόγοι καὶ φρεναπάται, μάλιστα οἱ ἐκ τῆς περιτομῆς,

text_en: Who must be reproved, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
text_la: quos oportet redargui : qui universas domos subvertunt, docentes quæ non oportet, turpis lucri gratia.
text_pt: Aos quais convém tapar a boca; homens que transtornam casas inteiras ensinando o que não convém, por torpe ganância.
text_el: οὓς δεῖ ἐπιστομίζειν, οἵτινες ὅλους οἴκους ἀνατρέπουσιν διδάσκοντες ἃ μὴ δεῖ αἰσχροῦ κέρδους χάριν.

text_en: One of them a prophet of their own, said: The Cretans are always liars , evil beasts, slothful bellies.
text_la: Dixit quidam ex illis, proprius ipsorum propheta : Cretenses semper mendaces, malæ bestiæ, ventres pigri.
text_pt: Um deles, seu próprio profeta, disse: Os cretenses são sempre mentirosos, bestas ruins, ventres preguiçosos.
text_el: εἶπέν τις ἐξ αὐτῶν, ἴδιος αὐτῶν προφήτης, Κρῆτες ἀεὶ ψεῦσται, κακὰ θηρία, γαστέρες ἀργαί.

text_en: This testimony is true . Wherefore, rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith :
text_la: Testimonium hoc verum est. Quam ob causam increpa illos dure, ut sani sint in fide,
text_pt: Este testemunho é verdadeiro. Portanto, repreende-os severamente, para que sejam sãos na fé.
text_el: ἡ μαρτυρία αὕτη ἐστὶν ἀληθής. δι' ἣν αἰτίαν ἔλεγχε αὐτοὺς ἀποτόμως, ἵνα ὑγιαίνωσιν [ἐν] τῇ πίστει,

text_en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn themselves away from the truth .
text_la: non intendentes judaicis fabulis, et mandatis hominum, aversantium se a veritate.
text_pt: Não dando ouvidos às fábulas judaicas, nem aos mandamentos de homens que se desviam da verdade.
text_el: μὴ προσέχοντες Ἰουδαϊκοῖς μύθοις καὶ ἐντολαῖς ἀνθρώπων ἀποστρεφομένων τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

text_en: All things are clean to the clean: but to them that are defiled and to unbelievers, nothing is clean: but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.
text_la: Omnia munda mundis : coinquinatis autem et infidelibus, nihil est mundum, sed inquinatæ sunt eorum et mens et conscientia.
text_pt: Todas as coisas são puras para os puros, mas nada é puro para os contaminados e infiéis; antes o seu entendimento e consciência estão contaminados.
text_el: πάντα καθαρὰ τοῖς καθαροῖς: τοῖς δὲ μεμιαμμένοις καὶ ἀπίστοις οὐδὲν καθαρόν, ἀλλὰ μεμίανται αὐτῶν καὶ ὁ νοῦς καὶ ἡ συνείδησις.

text_en: They profess that they know God : but in their works they deny him: being abominable and incredulous and to every good work reprobate.
text_la: Confitentur se nosse Deum, factis autem negant : cum sint abominati, et incredibiles, et ad omne opus bonum reprobi.
text_pt: Confessam que conhecem a Deus, mas negam-no com as obras, sendo abomináveis, e desobedientes, e reprovados para toda a boa obra.
text_el: θεὸν ὁμολογοῦσιν εἰδέναι, τοῖς δὲ ἔργοις ἀρνοῦνται, βδελυκτοὶ ὄντες καὶ ἀπειθεῖς καὶ πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἀδόκιμοι.

text_en: But speak the things that become sound doctrine:
text_la: Tu autem loquere quæ decent sanam doctrinam:
text_pt: Tu, porém, fala o que convém à sã doutrina.
text_el: Σὺ δὲ λάλει ἃ πρέπει τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ.

text_en: That the aged men be sober, chaste , prudent , sound in faith , in love , in patience.
text_la: senes ut sobrii sint, pudici, prudentes, sani in fide, in dilectione, in patientia:
text_pt: Os velhos, que sejam sóbrios, graves, prudentes, sãos na fé, no amor, e na paciência;
text_el: πρεσβύτας νηφαλίους εἶναι, σεμνούς, σώφρονας, ὑγιαίνοντας τῇ πίστει, τῇ ἀγάπῃ, τῇ ὑπομονῇ.

text_en: The aged women , in like manner, in holy attire, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teaching well:
text_la: anus similiter in habitu sancto, non criminatrices, non multo vino servientes, bene docentes:
text_pt: As mulheres idosas, semelhantemente, que sejam sérias no seu viver, como convém a santas, não caluniadoras, não dadas a muito vinho, mestras no bem;
text_el: πρεσβύτιδας ὡσαύτως ἐν καταστήματι ἱεροπρεπεῖς, μὴ διαβόλους μηδὲ οἴνῳ πολλῷ δεδουλωμένας, καλοδιδασκάλους,

text_en: That they may teach the young women to be wise, to love their husbands, to love their children.
text_la: ut prudentiam doceant adolescentulas, ut viros suos ament, filios suos diligant,
text_pt: Para que ensinem as mulheres novas a serem prudentes, a amarem seus maridos, a amarem seus filhos,
text_el: ἵνα σωφρονίζωσιν τὰς νέας φιλάνδρους εἶναι, φιλοτέκνους,

text_en: To be discreet, chaste , sober, having a care of the house, gentle, obedient to their husbands: that the word of God be not blasphemed .
text_la: prudentes, castas, sobrias, domus curam habentes, benignas, subditas viris suis, ut non blasphemetur verbum Dei.
text_pt: A serem moderadas, castas, boas donas de casa, sujeitas a seus maridos, a fim de que a palavra de Deus não seja blasfemada.
text_el: σώφρονας, ἁγνάς, οἰκουργούς ἀγαθάς, ὑποτασσομένας τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν, ἵνα μὴ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ βλασφημῆται.

text_en: Young men , in like manner, exhort that they be sober.
text_la: Juvenes similiter hortare ut sobrii sint.
text_pt: Exorta semelhantemente os jovens a que sejam moderados.
text_el: Τοὺς νεωτέρους ὡσαύτως παρακάλει σωφρονεῖν

text_en: In all things show yourself an example of good works, in doctrine, in integrity, in gravity,
text_la: In omnibus teipsum præbe exemplum bonorum operum, in doctrina, in integritate, in gravitate,
text_pt: Em tudo te dá por exemplo de boas obras; na doutrina mostra incorrupção, gravidade, sinceridade,
text_el: περὶ πάντα, σεαυτὸν παρεχόμενος τύπον καλῶν ἔργων, ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀφθορίαν, σεμνότητα,

text_en: the sound word that can not be blamed: that he who is on the contrary part may be afraid, having no evil to say of us.
text_la: verbum sanum, irreprehensibile : ut is qui ex adverso est, vereatur, nihil habens malum dicere de nobis.
text_pt: Linguagem sã e irrepreensível, para que o adversário se envergonhe, não tendo nenhum mal que dizer de nós.
text_el: λόγον ὑγιῆ ἀκατάγνωστον, ἵνα ὁ ἐξ ἐναντίας ἐντραπῇ μηδὲν ἔχων λέγειν περὶ ἡμῶν φαῦλον.

text_en: Exhort servants to be obedient to their masters: in all things pleasing, not gainsaying:
text_la: Servos dominis suis subditos esse, in omnibus placentes, non contradicentes,
text_pt: Exorta os servos a que se sujeitem a seus senhores, e em tudo agradem, não contradizendo,
text_el: Δούλους ἰδίοις δεσπόταις ὑποτάσσεσθαι ἐν πᾶσιν, εὐαρέστους εἶναι, μὴ ἀντιλέγοντας,

text_en: Not defrauding, but in all things showing good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
text_la: non fraudantes, sed in omnibus fidem bonam ostendentes : ut doctrinam Salvatoris nostri Dei ornent in omnibus.
text_pt: Não defraudando, antes mostrando toda a boa lealdade, para que em tudo sejam ornamento da doutrina de Deus, nosso Salvador.
text_el: μὴ νοσφιζομένους, ἀλλὰ πᾶσαν πίστιν ἐνδεικνυμένους ἀγαθήν, ἵνα τὴν διδασκαλίαν τὴν τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ κοσμῶσιν ἐν πᾶσιν.

text_en: For the grace of God our Saviour has appeared to all men :
text_la: Apparuit enim gratia Dei Salvatoris nostri omnibus hominibus,
text_pt: Porque a graça salvadora de Deus se há manifestado a todos os homens,
text_el: Ἐπεφάνη γὰρ ἡ χάρις τοῦ θεοῦ σωτήριος πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις,

text_en: Instructing us, that, denying ungodliness and worldly desires, we should live soberly and justly and godly in this world,
text_la: erudiens nos, ut abnegantes impietatem, et sæcularia desideria, sobrie, et juste, et pie vivamus in hoc sæculo,
text_pt: Ensinando-nos que, renunciando à impiedade e às concupiscências mundanas, vivamos neste presente século sóbria, e justa, e piamente,
text_el: παιδεύουσα ἡμᾶς ἵνα ἀρνησάμενοι τὴν ἀσέβειαν καὶ τὰς κοσμικὰς ἐπιθυμίας σωφρόνως καὶ δικαίως καὶ εὐσεβῶς ζήσωμεν ἐν τῷ νῦν αἰῶνι,

text_en: looking for the blessed hope and coming of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ .
text_la: exspectantes beatam spem, et adventum gloriæ magni Dei, et Salvatoris nostri Jesu Christi:
text_pt: Aguardando a bem-aventurada esperança e o aparecimento da glória do grande Deus e nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo;
text_el: προσδεχόμενοι τὴν μακαρίαν ἐλπίδα καὶ ἐπιφάνειαν τῆς δόξης τοῦ μεγάλου θεοῦ καὶ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ,

text_en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and might cleanse to himself a people acceptable, a pursuer of good works.
text_la: qui dedit semetipsum pro nobis, ut nos redimeret ab omni iniquitate, et mundaret sibi populum acceptabilem, sectatorem bonorum operum.
text_pt: O qual se deu a si mesmo por nós para nos remir de toda a iniqüidade, e purificar para si um povo seu especial, zeloso de boas obras.
text_el: ὃς ἔδωκεν ἑαυτὸν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα λυτρώσηται ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀνομίας καὶ καθαρίσῃ ἑαυτῷ λαὸν περιούσιον, ζηλωτὴν καλῶν ἔργων.

text_en: These things speak and exhort and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise you.
text_la: Hæc loquere, et exhortare, et argue cum omni imperio. Nemo te contemnat.
text_pt: Fala disto, e exorta e repreende com toda a autoridade. Ninguém te despreze.
text_el: Ταῦτα λάλει καὶ παρακάλει καὶ ἔλεγχε μετὰ πάσης ἐπιταγῆς: μηδείς σου περιφρονείτω.

text_en: Admonish them to be subject to princes and powers, to obey at a word, to be ready to every good work.
text_la: Admone illos principibus, et potestatibus subditos esse, dicto obedire, ad omne opus bonum paratos esse:
text_pt: Admoesta-os a que se sujeitem aos principados e potestades, que lhes obedeçam, e estejam preparados para toda a boa obra;
text_el: Ὑπομίμνῃσκε αὐτοὺς ἀρχαῖς ἐξουσίαις ὑποτάσσεσθαι, πειθαρχεῖν, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἑτοίμους εἶναι,

text_en: To speak evil of no man , not to be litigious but gentle: showing all mildness towards all men .
text_la: neminem blasphemare, non litigiosos esse, sed modestos, omnem ostendentes mansuetudinem ad omnes homines.
text_pt: Que a ninguém infamem, nem sejam contenciosos, mas modestos, mostrando toda a mansidão para com todos os homens.
text_el: μηδένα βλασφημεῖν, ἀμάχους εἶναι, ἐπιεικεῖς, πᾶσαν ἐνδεικνυμένους πραΰτητα πρὸς πάντας ἀνθρώπους.

text_en: For we ourselves also were some time unwise, incredulous, erring , slaves to divers desires and pleasures, living in malice and envy , hateful and hating one another.
text_la: Eramus enim aliquando et nos insipientes, increduli, errantes, servientes desideriis, et voluptatibus variis, in malitia et invidia agentes, odibiles, odientes invicem.
text_pt: Porque também nós éramos noutro tempo insensatos, desobedientes, extraviados, servindo a várias concupiscências e deleites, vivendo em malícia e inveja, odiosos, odiando-nos uns aos outros.
text_el: ἦμεν γάρ ποτε καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀνόητοι, ἀπειθεῖς, πλανώμενοι, δουλεύοντες ἐπιθυμίαις καὶ ἡδοναῖς ποικίλαις, ἐν κακίᾳ καὶ φθόνῳ διάγοντες, στυγητοί, μισοῦντες ἀλλήλους.

text_en: But when the goodness and kindness of God our Saviour appeared:
text_la: Cum autem benignitas et humanitas apparuit Salvatoris nostri Dei,
text_pt: Mas quando apareceu a benignidade e amor de Deus, nosso Salvador, para com os homens,
text_el: ὅτε δὲ ἡ χρηστότης καὶ ἡ φιλανθρωπία ἐπεφάνη τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν θεοῦ,

text_en: Not by the works of justice which we have done, but according to his mercy, he saved us, by the laver of regeneration and renovation of the Holy Ghost .
text_la: non ex operibus justitiæ, quæ fecimus nos, sed secundum suam misericordiam salvos nos fecit per lavacrum regenerationis et renovationis Spiritus Sancti,
text_pt: Não pelas obras de justiça que houvéssemos feito, mas segundo a sua misericórdia, nos salvou pela lavagem da regeneração e da renovação do Espírito Santo,
text_el: οὐκ ἐξ ἔργων τῶν ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἃ ἐποιήσαμεν ἡμεῖς ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ αὐτοῦ ἔλεος ἔσωσεν ἡμᾶς διὰ λουτροῦ παλιγγενεσίας καὶ ἀνακαινώσεως πνεύματος ἁγίου,

text_en: Whom he has poured forth upon us abundantly, through Jesus Christ our Saviour :
text_la: quem effudit in nos abunde per Jesum Christum Salvatorem nostrum:
text_pt: Que abundantemente ele derramou sobre nós por Jesus Cristo nosso Salvador;
text_el: οὗ ἐξέχεεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς πλουσίως διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν,

text_en: That, being justified by his grace , we may be heirs according to hope of life everlasting.
text_la: ut justificati gratia ipsius, hæredes simus secundum spem vitæ æternæ.
text_pt: Para que, sendo justificados pela sua graça, sejamos feitos herdeiros segundo a esperança da vida eterna.
text_el: ἵνα δικαιωθέντες τῇ ἐκείνου χάριτι κληρονόμοι γενηθῶμεν κατ' ἐλπίδα ζωῆς αἰωνίου.

text_en: It is a faithful saying. And these things I will have you affirm constantly, that they who believe in God may be careful to excel in good works. These things are good and profitable unto men .
text_la: Fidelis sermo est : et de his volo te confirmare : ut curent bonis operibus præesse qui credunt Deo. Hæc sunt bona, et utilia hominibus.
text_pt: Fiel é a palavra, e isto quero que deveras afirmes, para que os que crêem em Deus procurem aplicar-se às boas obras; estas coisas são boas e proveitosas aos homens.
text_el: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος, καὶ περὶ τούτων βούλομαί σε διαβεβαιοῦσθαι, ἵνα φροντίζωσιν καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι οἱ πεπιστευκότες θεῷ. ταῦτά ἐστιν καλὰ καὶ ὠφέλιμα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις:

text_en: But avoid foolish questions and genealogies and contentions and strivings about the law. For they are unprofitable and vain.
text_la: Stultas autem quæstiones, et genealogias, et contentiones, et pugnas legis devita : sunt enim inutiles, et vanæ.
text_pt: Mas não entres em questões loucas, genealogias e contendas, e nos debates acerca da lei; porque são coisas inúteis e vãs.
text_el: μωρὰς δὲ ζητήσεις καὶ γενεαλογίας καὶ ἔριν καὶ μάχας νομικὰς περιΐστασο, εἰσὶν γὰρ ἀνωφελεῖς καὶ μάταιοι.

text_en: A man that is a heretic, after the first and second admonition, avoid:
text_la: Hæreticum hominem post unam et secundam correptionem devita:
text_pt: Ao homem hereje, depois de uma e outra admoestação, evita-o,
text_el: αἱρετικὸν ἄνθρωπον μετὰ μίαν καὶ δευτέραν νουθεσίαν παραιτοῦ,

text_en: Knowing that he that is such an one is subverted and sins , being condemned by his own judgment.
text_la: sciens quia subversus est, qui ejusmodi est, et delinquit, cum sit proprio judicio condemnatus.
text_pt: Sabendo que esse tal está pervertido, e peca, estando já em si mesmo condenado.
text_el: εἰδὼς ὅτι ἐξέστραπται ὁ τοιοῦτος καὶ ἁμαρτάνει, ὢν αὐτοκατάκριτος.

text_en: When I shall send to you Artemas or Tychicus , make haste to come unto me to Nicopolis . For there I have determined to winter.
text_la: Cum misero ad te Artemam, aut Tychicum, festina ad me venire Nicopolim : ibi enim statui hiemare.
text_pt: Quando te enviar Ártemas, ou Tíquico, procura vir ter comigo a Nicópolis; porque deliberei invernar ali.
text_el: Ὅταν πέμψω Ἀρτεμᾶν πρὸς σὲ ἢ Τυχικόν, σπούδασον ἐλθεῖν πρός με εἰς Νικόπολιν, ἐκεῖ γὰρ κέκρικα παραχειμάσαι.

text_en: Send forward Zenas the lawyer and Apollo, with care that nothing be wanting to them.
text_la: Zenam legisperitum et Apollo sollicite præmitte, ut nihil illis desit.
text_pt: Acompanha com muito cuidado Zenas, doutor da lei, e Apolo, para que nada lhes falte.
text_el: Ζηνᾶν τὸν νομικὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν σπουδαίως πρόπεμψον, ἵνα μηδὲν αὐτοῖς λείπῃ.

text_en: And let our men also learn to excel in good works for necessary uses: that they be not unfruitful.
text_la: Discant autem et nostri bonis operibus præesse ad usus necessarios : ut non sint infructuosi.
text_pt: E os nossos aprendam também a aplicar-se às boas obras, nas coisas necessárias, para que não sejam infrutuosos.
text_el: μανθανέτωσαν δὲ καὶ οἱ ἡμέτεροι καλῶν ἔργων προΐστασθαι εἰς τὰς ἀναγκαίας χρείας, ἵνα μὴ ὦσιν ἄκαρποι.

text_en: All that are with me salute you. Salute them that love us in the faith . The grace of God be with you all. Amen .
text_la: Salutant te qui mecum sunt omnes : saluta eos qui nos amant in fide. Gratia Dei cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
text_pt: Saúdam-te todos os que estão comigo. Saúda tu os que nos amam na fé. A graça seja com vós todos. Amém.
text_el: Ἀσπάζονταί σε οἱ μετ' ἐμοῦ πάντες. ἄσπασαι τοὺς φιλοῦντας ἡμᾶς ἐν πίστει. Ἡ χάρις μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν.
